research_triage.purpose: Extract source-linked facts from papers, repositories, profiles, and logs.

research_synthesis.purpose: Turn dossier and experiment evidence into hypotheses and gaps.

candidate_design.purpose: Propose one bounded reversible candidate and evaluation plan.

code_change_proposal.purpose: Draft a minimal source change after profiler and compatibility evidence support it.

failure_triage.purpose: Classify failures and retry safety from logs and artifacts.

policy_critic.purpose: Challenge unsafe assumptions, missing gates, and budget risk.
